item: EthicalFetcher connect scope allows only the proxy each request uses
summary: _guarded_redirect_get gave connect_scope the whole merged proxy mapping, so a hostname proxy for another scheme (HTTPS_PROXY naming a corporate proxy, a plain-http page) stood the connect-time check down for a request that went direct, reopening the DNS-rebinding window (reproduced red). Each request now runs in a nested scope holding the one proxy requests.utils.select_proxy picks for its URL, merged per hop as requests merges it.
